latin: Cur homo non possit non uideri si sit presens a recte disposito in potentia uisiua, demon autem tunc solum uideatur cum uult uideri, ex modo quo unusquisque eorum uidetur haberi potest.
translation: Why a man cannot fail to be seen if he is present to one rightly disposed in the visual faculty, while a demon is seen only when it wishes to be seen, can be understood from the manner in which each of them is seen.
